title: Successive quotient normalizations under the pulled reduction comparison
statement:
Let $g:T'\to T$ be a morphism of schemes and use the adic datum, small pro-etale sites and coefficient sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For $W=T,T'$ put $B_W=A_W$, $R_W=\underline A_W$ and $S_{n,W}=(P_n)_W$. Let $K\in D(B_T)$ be arbitrary, $K_n=K\otimes^L_{B_T}S_{n,T}$, $N=Lg_R^*\operatorname{Res}_T K$, $N_n=N\otimes^L_{R_{T'}}S_{n,T'}$, and $H_n=Lg_n^*K_n$. Use finite module pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] and the specified finite coefficient isomorphisms $\tau_n:N_n\xrightarrow{\sim}H_n$ of [lem-weil-pbc-pulled-reduction-strict-tower-comparison].

For $b\geq a\geq1$ let $\theta^N_{b,a}:N_b\otimes^L_{S_{b,T'}}S_{a,T'}\to N_a$ be successive scalar-extension normalization [lem-sfb-successive-derived-quotient-normalization]. Define $\theta^H_{b,a}:H_b\otimes^L_{S_{b,T'}}S_{a,T'}\to H_a$ by the canonical pullback/scalar-extension comparison followed by $Lg_a^*$ of the normalization $K_b\otimes^L_{S_{b,T}}S_{a,T}\to K_a$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Then $\theta^H_{b,a}$ is invertible and
$$\theta^H_{b,a}\circ(\tau_b\otimes^L1)=\tau_a\circ\theta^N_{b,a}.$$
The comparisons are natural in $K$. For $c\geq b\geq a$, successive $\theta^H_{c,b}$ and $\theta^H_{b,a}$ equal $\theta^H_{c,a}$ under canonical derived scalar associativity; for $b=a$ the map $\theta^H_{a,a}$ is the scalar-extension unit identification.

On a flat-term K-flat representative $P$ of $K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], these are the derived maps induced by the balancing maps $(x\otimes t)\otimes s\mapsto x\otimes q_{b,a}(t)s$ before and after inverse image and scalar extension. The two triple-normalization composites are the map $((x\otimes t)\otimes s)\otimes v\mapsto x\otimes q_{c,a}(t)q_{b,a}(s)v$ under the same comparisons. These formulas specify morphisms of sheaf tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and the stated comparisons and equalities hold independently of the chosen K-flat representative.
